name: Liofilchem
description: Italian manufacturer of ready-to-use culture media and antimicrobial susceptibility testing products. Their plates, tubes, and MIC strips are used in clinical microbiology labs for pathogen isolation and resistance profiling, with product lines aligned to both EUCAST and CLSI standards.
products: Culture media (ready-to-use plates, tubes, bottles), antimicrobial susceptibility discs and strips, rapid diagnostic kits

name: Sacace Biotechnologies
description: Italian developer of real-time and conventional PCR kits covering hepatitis, HIV, HPV, respiratory infections, and STIs. Sacace kits are a practical choice for Indian referral labs building out molecular diagnostics without committing to a single-platform ecosystem.
products: Real-time PCR kits, conventional PCR kits, DNA/RNA extraction kits, molecular diagnostics reagents

name: ViennaLab Diagnostics
description: Austrian specialist in StripAssay reverse-hybridization kits for pharmacogenetics, thrombophilia screening, and HLA typing. The strip-based format lets labs offer targeted genotyping panels without the capital investment of next-gen sequencing.
products: StripAssay kits (pharmacogenetics, cardiovascular, HLA), RealFast PCR kits, PGX genotyping panels

name: Micreos Food Safety BV
description: Dutch company behind PhageGuard, a bacteriophage-based approach to food safety. PhageGuard Listex targets Listeria and PhageGuard S targets Salmonella on food contact surfaces, without chemicals or antibiotics. Increasingly relevant for Indian food exporters meeting international standards.
products: PhageGuard Listex (anti-Listeria), PhageGuard S (anti-Salmonella), bacteriophage-based biocontrol solutions

name: Medix Biochemica Oy
description: Finnish supplier of antibodies, antigens, and enzymes used by IVD manufacturers to build diagnostic assays. Medix raw materials go into cardiac marker, infectious disease, and hormone assays produced by kit makers worldwide, including several in India.
products: Monoclonal antibodies, polyclonal antibodies, antigens, enzymes (HRP, AP), blocking reagents

name: Candor Bioscience
description: German immunoassay optimization specialist, part of the Medix Biochemica group. Their LowCross-Buffer and Assay Defender reagents solve real development headaches: heterophilic antibody interference, high background signal, and poor reagent shelf life in ELISA and lateral flow formats.
products: LowCross-Buffer, Assay Defender, sample diluents, blocking solutions, stabilizers for ELISA and lateral flow
